verdict.rationale: Kit documents an official remote MCP server (the Kit MCP) that exposes a creator's account to MCP-compatible AI clients. It covers subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags and segments, with read and write access, so prompts like "draft a broadcast" become real account actions. A separate official Developer Docs MCP gives coding agents live API docs, and a probe confirms the MCP docs exist and are linked from llms.txt. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that connecting an agent works, and evidenced details of client connection and authentication setup.
